title: KLIA Terminal 1 2026 — Static & Digital Airport Media
summary: 2026 static from RM150k/yr; Arrivals Impact Duo RM1.25M; digital from RM30k/mo, Aerostation RM120k/mo, Departures Branding Zone RM150k/mo.
description: KLIA Terminal 1 2026 static and digital decks (56 + 62 pages). Passenger traffic ranges from 2.9M to 3.5M per month (Sep 2025–Sep 2026). Static: Arrivals BDC Impact RM150,000/year; Arrivals Impact Duo RM1.25M; Arrivals Impact Icons RM1.2M–1.25M; Baggage Carousel Flaps RM500,000; Contact Pier Icon RM900,000; Contact Pier Gates RM1.5M; Departures Immigration Domination RM1.875M; Satellite Pier Domination RM2.1M; Transit Train Station Domination RM2M; Transit Train Sponsorship RM3.5M; trolleys RM12,000/month. Digital: Screens & Charging Network from RM30,000/month (RM950,000/year); Departures Network RM60,000/month; Satellite Impact Network RM60,000/month; Arrivals Impact Network RM75,000/month; Aerostation, Arrivals Spectacular, Digital Dream and Duty-Free Spectacular RM100,000–120,000/month; Departures Branding Zone RM150,000/month. Rates exclude 8% SST; production and lighting charges apply.
